title: Lower Costs, More Transparency Act
description: Requires hospitals and insurers to publicly disclose negotiated rates. Bans anti-competitive gag clauses in insurance contracts. Strengthens price transparency enforcement.

title: Preserving Telehealth, Hospital, and Ambulance Access Act
description: Extends Medicare telehealth flexibilities through 2024 including audio-only visits, hospital-at-home programs, and expanded telehealth provider eligibility.

title: Inflation Reduction Act of 2022
description: Allows Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices for the first time. Caps insulin at $35/month for Medicare. Extends ACA premium subsidies through 2025.

title: Elijah E. Cummings Lower Drug Costs Now Act
description: Allows Medicare to negotiate prices for up to 250 drugs. Caps out-of-pocket costs for Medicare Part D. Requires drug companies to offer negotiated prices to commercial insurers.

title: American Rescue Plan Act of 2021
description: Expanded ACA premium tax credits, increased subsidies for marketplace plans, provided COBRA subsidies, and funded COVID-19 healthcare response including vaccine distribution.

title: Postal Service Reform Act of 2022
description: Requires postal retirees to enroll in Medicare. Eliminates pre-funding mandate for retiree health benefits. Impacts Medicare enrollment and spending projections.

title: Strengthening Health Care and Lowering Prescription Drug Costs Act
description: Reversed Trump-era ACA sabotage efforts. Restored cost-sharing reduction payments, blocked short-term insurance expansion, and funded ACA enrollment outreach.

title: PATIENT Act of 2022
description: Extends Medicare sequester relief and delays scheduled cuts to Medicare physician payments. Addresses the annual 'doc fix' cycle.

title: HEALTH Act
description: Expands mental health parity enforcement, increases funding for community mental health centers, and requires insurers to cover mental health services at parity with physical health.

title: Bipartisan Primary Care and Health Workforce Act
description: Increases Medicare graduate medical education slots, funds primary care training, and creates incentives for physicians to practice in underserved areas.

title: Site-Based Invoicing and Transparency Enhancement (SITE) Act
description: Establishes site-neutral payment policies requiring hospitals to bill the same rates regardless of whether care is delivered in an outpatient department or physician office.

title: Health Care Affordability Act of 2025
description: Makes permanent the expanded ACA premium tax credits from the Inflation Reduction Act. Expands eligibility for marketplace subsidies.
